## What's new in Kraki 0.2.77
- **Custom Words sync right away.** Words you add or remove on your phone or in the browser show up on this Mac immediately, and removed words no longer come back. - **Sign Out works.** Kraki stays signed out until you sign in again; this Mac keeps serving its agents meanwhile. - **After a restart** the menu bar shows whether this Mac is online, even before you open the window. - **Updating** no longer asks whether to take this Mac offline. - **Devices:** remove an old device in Settings › Devices, and see when an offline one was last online. - **Offline computers:** the message box stays and your message is delivered when the computer is back. - **Steps** show each permission once, with what happened: Approved, or Denied with your reason. - **Sessions:** Rename… and Archive in the session menu; forks are named "Fork of …"; one name for each model everywhere. - Settings follow Light/Dark, and say plainly when notifications are off or voice isn't available.

## What's Changed * fix(mac): own executable UUIDs for the CLI and built-in helper (local network access) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/433 * fix(voice): first-use cloud notice, secret filter, broker pinning, honest copy by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/423 * release: Tentacle 0.38.2 (protocol 0.28.1) — npm installs start again by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/435 * fix: P3 sweep 1 — independent files (crypto/protocol bounds, voice, guard, CI pins, installers) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/426 * fix: P3 sweep 2 — remaining review findings by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/439 * fix: keep replies visible after a turn lost in a daemon restart by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/440 * release: Tentacle 0.38.3 (protocol 0.29.0, crypto 0.2.2), Mac 0.2.75 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/441 * fix: stability and perf issues found in client diagnostics (tab eviction storm, double answer, backgrounded voice, diag batch loss, session_list cost) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/442 * release: Head 0.20.1 (protocol 0.29.1), Mac 0.2.76 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/443
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.74...mac-v0.2.76
